title: Error responses are plain text, not JSON
evidence: main.go:73,77,82 use http.Error which sends text/plain; only success paths encode JSON
suggestion: Encode error responses as JSON objects (e.g. {"error": "..."}) for consistency with the JSON-API requirement

title: Year and ISBN use omitempty, hiding zero/empty values
evidence: main.go:20-21 `Year int json:"year,omitempty"` — a book with year 0 or empty ISBN omits the field in responses
suggestion: Drop omitempty if the API should always surface these fields, or make them pointers to distinguish unset from zero

title: Coverage 59.6% — main() and several error branches untested
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.596; no tests for validation-rejection (400), not-found (404 on GET), or malformed JSON
suggestion: Add tests for the 400 validation path and 404/invalid-JSON error paths to raise coverage
